note: Each wasm build profile's gzipped size, held by `cargo xtask footprint
--profile NAME --gzipped BYTES --run REV@HOST --date DAY`. A local run
builds the profile as release.yml's npm job builds the wasm, under the
job's `RUSTFLAGS` of `-D warnings`: `wasm-pack build --release --target
web --out-dir pkg bindings/js`, followed by `-- --features bundled-fonts`
for that profile, counts `gzip -9 -c bindings/js/pkg/tinker_pdf_js_bg.wasm
| wc -c` and passes the number in. A size over `figure.bytes` plus
`tolerance.bytes` fails; a shrink passes and prints the `--record` line
that writes it as the figure, with its run and day, keeping the
tolerance. A profile with no entry fails unless the run names it
`--unrecorded`.
`figure` is one run's measurement: `bytes`, the `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and
the `run`, `<revision>@<host>`, the commit it built and the target triple
of the host that built it, with `#<n>` for the nth build of one revision
on one host. `tolerance` is measured, never assumed: `bytes` is the
widest spread of one revision's size over the `runs` it names, five clean
builds and one more under the previous stable toolchain, and `toolchains`
names the compilers they built with; zero is a measurement too. A clean
build deletes `bindings/js/target` and `bindings/js/pkg` first, so each
compiles the revision anew. `cargo xtask check` refuses an entry missing
any of these, or carrying a key nothing reads.
The wasm carries the paths of the engine's sources as the build saw them,
so where a checkout sits can move the size as well. A profile's first
figure and tolerance are written by hand from its runs; `--record` only
moves a figure whose tolerance it keeps.
